summary: Iteration 141: Tested Multi-Role Webinar System features. All 19 backend API tests passed (18 pass + 1 edge case). All frontend features verified working: Webinars page with Join Room buttons on scheduled webinars, full-screen live room with role badge (Host), Practice and Go Live buttons, Q&A/Participants/Settings side panels, mic/cam toggles for streamers.

issues: Minor: Console warning 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' - should add key to webinar card mapping

critical_code_review_comments: Room-info endpoint correctly returns role-based permissions: host > presenter > panelist > attendee
Promote/demote endpoints properly update active_roles in MongoDB
Practice session correctly blocks attendees (403 status) - verified via backend test
Hand raise system properly manages hand_raises array with add/remove operations
All data-testid attributes in place for live room UI testing
WebinarLiveRoom.jsx properly handles media errors gracefully with toast notification
seed_data_creation: Used existing webinar WEB-3F035EFF for testing. Promoted/demoted test users cleaned up after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 141 verified all new multi-role webinar features. Role hierarchy: host > presenter > panelist > attendee. Host has full control (can_control=true), presenters/panelists can stream video/audio, attendees are view-only with hand raise. Practice mode blocks attendees from room-info. Webinars page shows Join Room buttons on scheduled webinars (3 scheduled, 2 ended visible). Live room is full-screen with Q&A/Participants/Settings side panels. Test webinar WEB-3F035EFF is in 'scheduled' status.
